summary:
Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository, by reading and editing files only. Nothing was run and nothing was committed.

Changes:
- rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 after ERASE_IN_LINE; ControlCode union now includes Tuple[ControlType, str].
- rich/control.py: formatting entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL (title unmodified); Control.title(title) classmethod with docstring and Args entry.
- rich/console.py: Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor. Buffers Control.title only when is_terminal is true; returns that result. Google-style docstring covers the no-restore, may-reset, and true-means-written points.
- rich/_windows_renderer.py: one new elif branch calling term.set_title(title) once per title control.
- CHANGELOG.md: Unreleased "Added" bullet linking pull request 2200.
- Tests: test_console.py (test_set_window_title, skipped on Windows), test_control.py (test_control_title), test_windows_renderer.py (test_control_set_window_title, Windows only, expects set_title("Hello, world!")).

Not verified: tests, mypy, and Black were not run, per instructions. Formatting and typing were checked by reading only.

Choice: the Console method gates on is_terminal directly, mirroring show_cursor, rather than control()'s is_dumb_terminal gate.
